A small video inset at the top shows an older man in a suit gesturing behind a podium in a legislative chamber. (2) The young man begins an energetic singing performance, moving his body rhythmically and waving his hands broadly. He looks directly at the camera with an intense, focused expression while frequently touching his hair. The microphone is positioned close to his mouth as he performs with high physical energy. (3) The performer expresses a sense of frantic haste, grabbing his head with both hands and gesturing wildly to match the rhythm of the music. The lighting is bright and even across the room, highlighting the blue texture of the background wall and the wooden details of the bed. (4) Reaching the climax of his performance, the man leans his head back while sustaining a long note. He then abruptly exits the frame to the left, leaving the empty microphone stand and the bedroom background visible for a split second before the video cuts.
